constraints: A DWG handle payload may contain up to eight bytes.
The current DICTIONARY and GROUP public graph models retain referenced object IDs as uint32_t.
A wider common-tail or dictionary-entry handle cannot be represented without truncation and must not alias its low 32-bit value.

implementation.failureState: typed entries and completeness state reset after refusal
implementation.retry: the valid AC1012 frame parses successfully after each malformed frame
